The '''4-X blaster rifle''' was a [[Blaster rifle/Legends|blaster rifle]] manufactured by [[Atgar SpaceDefense Corporation/Legends|Atgar SpaceDefense Corporation]] and commonly used by the [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].
